artifact_retention: immutable serialized prompt, token IDs, Q1/Q2 ranges, provenance, and no-outcome attestation
all per-rank raw per-query capture records for every Q1/Q2 content-token row
token-aligned query-summed vectors plus per-query rows
server/model load logs and HBM inventory

main full-candidate reference logits and native pre-top-k indexer vectors are finite and causally coindexed

postprocessors.depends_on_artifact: complete strict-causal raw indexer matrix plus frozen matrix-episode manifest

postprocessors.cost: Capture storage and validation are O(layers * window_tokens^2); propagation is bounded by the same declared matrix.
success_criteria: every requested layer has one unique strict-causal row for every query in the declared window on every TP rank
the offline float64 recurrence, input hashes, per-hop contributions, cumulative scores, and exact unnormalized layer sums validate
